newsitem.title: UK: On Demand rises after director's purchase.
newsitem.headline: On Demand rises after director's purchase.

text.p: Shares in On Demand Information Plc extended recent gains on Wednesday following the purchase of 22,500 shares by chairman Graham Poulter, said by the company to have an interest in 41.25 percent of its stock.
In addition to the purchase by Poulter, the company said finance director David Storey bought 2,500 shares on Wednesday at 55p. By 1450 GMT, On Demand shares were up 5p at 57-1/2p.
The shares have surged higher this week after the Internet company said on Monday that it knew of no reason behind a recent slump to the lowest level since the company was floated in December 1993.
On Demand, an electronic information company, issued a profit warning on October 8 which sent its shares plummeting -- Brian Killen, London newsroom 44 171 542 7972
